core_move_guess: Re-express equations using variable substitution to identify equivalent forms.
trigger_cues: asks for same number of solutions
mini_steps: Simplify: y = a^y, which is the same form as the original equation
Take the square root: a^x = x or a^x = -x
The second equation a^x = -x does not necessarily have the same number of solutions
Substitute y = 2x: a^y = y, which is the same form as the original equation
wrong_move: Assuming that any transformation of the equation preserves the number of solutions without carefully considering the domain and range of the functions involved.
